title: Agent Invocation Failed Event
description: An agent invocation terminated with a non-recoverable error. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md.

error_code.description: Machine reason. The Hermes gateway uses processing_failed, processing_cancelled, route_policy_invalid_before_dispatch, turn_timeout (the lane's per-turn wall clock expired and the gateway stopped the turn; see elapsed_seconds, timeout_seconds, timeout_source and turn_stopped), hermes_refused (Hermes did not run the turn: it refused it with a notice a retry cannot fix, or kept refusing it until the command had no deliveries left; see refusal) and hermes_turn_error (a turn ran and Hermes ended it with an error notice such as a provider rate limit instead of an answer; see refusal).

context.description: Echo of the originating bloodbank.agent.invocation.start or .invoke command's data.context, verbatim. Ticket turns carry reason (ticket-grooming|ticket-delegation), repo, ticket_key, ticket_id, board_id, workspace, title and phase so consumers can act statelessly. Omitted when the command carried no context.

lane.description: Delivery lane of the originating command: batch (bloodbank.agent.invocation.start) or interactive (bloodbank.agent.invocation.invoke). Stamped by the Hermes gateway on every lifecycle fact; absent on facts written before the interactive lane existed.

elapsed_seconds.description: turn_timeout only: seconds between dispatching the turn to Hermes and stopping it.

timeout_seconds.description: turn_timeout only: the wall-clock budget that expired (the lane limit, or a shorter data.deadline_seconds from the command).

timeout_source.description: turn_timeout only: where the expired budget came from: the lane's turn_timeout_seconds, or the command's data.deadline_seconds.

turn_stopped.description: turn_timeout only: true when Hermes confirmed the turn is no longer running (session idle) after the gateway's stop; false when the stop could not be confirmed and the turn may still be unwinding.

refusal.description: hermes_refused and hermes_turn_error only: what Hermes answered instead of running the turn. A Hermes i18n notice key (gateway.busy.another_turn_running, gateway.unknown_command, gateway.busy.drain_rejected_new_work, gateway.errors.generic_failed_with_hint, ...), or the gateway's own reason: gateway_restarting / gateway_shutting_down / gateway_external_drain (Hermes was draining when the command came up for dispatch) and not_accepted (Hermes' ingress dropped the event without admitting it).
